Site handover23-Dec-2025

Scope: collector and local roads, potable water, sewage, storm drainage, irrigation, TSE, medium voltage, street lighting and telecom networks, a sewage pump station, storm drainage ponds, the boundary fence and guard room, and utility buildings, in the 2nd Industrial City in Dammam.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The weekly report (WPR-38) gives 32.47% actual against 68.43% planned in the original baseline and 50.23% in the revised plan. This week added 2.66% against 3.68% planned.

The project is forecast to finish 106 days late. The weekly report and the P6 update both forecast completion on 08-Jun-2027 against the contract date of 22-Feb-2027, and the completion milestone has −80 days of float in P6. Most networks have barely started: sewage is at 0.6%, potable water 5.5% and storm drainage 23.4% of their man-hours, while work is concentrated on the fence and guard room and the utility buildings. To finish on 22-Feb-2027 the remaining 67.53% must be done in 16 weeks, about 4.22% a week, against 2.66% this week.

The weekly report's network forecasts are 1 to 40 days later than the P6 update. Both give 08-Jun-2027 for completion, but the weekly report places the network milestones later than P6, most of all for TSE (05-Jun-2027 against 26-Apr-2027), irrigation (13-May-2027 against 12-Apr-2027) and medium voltage and street lighting (27 days each). The weekly report still marks milestones 2 to 4 as forecast, although P6 records them as complete.

Data notes

  • Data date: the cover sheet of WPR-38 states 29-Oct-2026; the P6 update, the procurement tracker and the failed-start list are dated 27-Oct-2026, and the look-ahead file is named 20-10-2026 but titled Update 27-10-2026.
  • Man-hour total: on the cover and Progress sheets the budgeted man-days of the construction WBS are shifted up one row. Sewage's 516 man-days are dropped and testing & commissioning's 1,899 appear against Utility Building, so the total is 18,474 instead of the 18,990 in P6 (151,920 man-hours). With the full budget, physical progress is 31.59%, as on the Physical-Chart Data sheet and in the P6 update. The headline uses the reported 32.47%.
  • Because of the shift, the per-phase percentages on the cover sheet are wrong (Storm Drainage shows 126.8% planned). The phase table uses the P6 extract on the Progress sheet instead. The cover also gives every phase the same original-plan figure (68.43%), so it has no real per-phase baseline.
  • Revised plan to date: 50.23% on the cover sheet against 41.04% for October on the Physical-Chart Data sheet.
  • The "last week earned" column on the Progress sheet counts the construction phases twice (total 8,245 man-days instead of 5,402). Its implied gain this week (597 man-days) also differs from the cover sheet's weekly figure (492 man-days, 2.66%).
  • This is the only week with files for this project, so the quantity "this week" column shows "—".
  • Contract duration: the cover gives 426 days to 22-Feb-2027, while the Milestones sheet says "Contract Weeks 44 of 65" and lists the completion baseline as 22-May-2027. P6 has a must-finish date of 23-Feb-2027.
  • Activity counts: the weekly report gives 310 completed, 47 in progress and 516 not started; the P6 update gives 331, 50 and 492.
  • The Conclusion sheet labels cost-based progress as "actual"; it is not used in this report. It also reports roads earthworks of 637,536 m³ against 720,764 m³ (excavation plus embankment) on the Major Quantities sheet.
  • Quantities: storm pipes show the same 1.62% finished on every line, and storm manholes fractional counts (0.198 of 20), so these values are pro-rated, not measured. The storm manholes are left out of the table.
  • Invoices: the cover sheet shows 2 invoices and 0 paid; the invoice log lists 3 invoices with the first two paid (3,596,613.90 SAR). The invoice log references DAMT-02-001 and gives a revised contract value of 21,100,000. The HSE inspection sheet also carries project ID DAMT-02-001 and the period 30-Sep to 06-Oct-2026.
  • Procurement tracker: the item summary and the quantity details disagree. Storm main-line pipes show 0 of 18 m against about 4,523 m delivered in the details; storm manholes 0 of 55 against 50 of 54; TSE pipes 0 against 1,200 m; sewage manholes 1,200 of 2,489.6 against 42 of 42. The chart uses the item summary and leaves out the storm main-line pipes, TSE pipes and sewage manholes.
  • The weekly manpower sheet's "actual" manual row repeats the planned cumulative values, so only this week's head count is shown.
  • The photos have no date or GPS stamp, and two uploaded photo files are identical.
